AboutCompany.title: About Happy Furniture
AboutCompany.desc1: Happy Furniture takes pride in being an expert in designing and manufacturing custom furniture directly from the factory. With over 10 years of experience in the engineered wood industry, we understand the need for a living space that is both aesthetic and functionally optimized at the most reasonable cost.
AboutCompany.desc2: We are committed to using premium moisture-resistant green core MDF from reputable suppliers, combined with modern machinery technology to create products with the sharpest finish.

Quality.title: Material & Construction Standards
Quality.desc: The difference that ensures decades of durability for Happy Furniture compared to mass-produced products on the market.
Quality.c1Desc: Absolutely no MFC particleboard or flimsy 15mm boards. We standardize the use of 17mm moisture-resistant green core MDF to ensure the cabinet structure is always solid and never sags.
Quality.c2Desc: Using automatic edge banding machines with waterproof PUR glue. Seamless edges with no black V-lines, completely preventing water from seeping into the wood core causing swelling and peeling.
Quality.c3Desc: Say no to cheap iron hinges that easily rust. All cabinets use stainless steel soft-close hinges and 3-tier ball-bearing slides, providing a smooth and silent opening/closing experience every day.
Quality.c4Desc: Unverified boards often contain Formaldehyde (causing eye irritation and strong odors). Our boards meet the E2 emission standard, with no toxic odors, extremely safe for families with young children and pregnant women.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: A summary of the most important information customers usually care about before deciding to make furniture.
FAQ.q1: What materials does the factory use to produce furniture?
FAQ.a1: Happy Furniture is committed to using 100% premium moisture-resistant green core MDF from reputable brands like Ba Thanh and An Cuong. The surface is covered with scratch-resistant Melamine, meeting E2 emission standards, absolutely safe for family health and durable in tropical climates.
FAQ.q2: Is moisture-resistant green core MDF really durable?
FAQ.a2: Very durable if processed accurately. Green core MDF combined with our factory's sealed edge-banding technology minimizes moisture intrusion. However, product lifespan (often 10 - 15 years) depends heavily on proper use and maintenance, especially keeping the home environment well-ventilated and avoiding direct water soaking.
FAQ.q3: Why is your factory's price higher than shelves sold on other online shops?
FAQ.a3: Cheap furniture on e-commerce platforms mostly uses thin 12mm - 15mm particleboard (MFC), non-moisture-resistant grade 2 boards, and manual gluing, making them prone to peeling and sagging after a few months. At Happy Furniture, we 100% standardize the use of 17mm thick moisture-resistant green core MDF and sturdy stainless steel soft-close hinges. The value you receive is absolute peace of mind and decades of durability.
FAQ.q4: Should I buy ready-made products on the Website or request custom dimensions?
FAQ.a4: If you need to optimize your budget, standard products on the website are a great choice as they are mass-produced at extremely good prices. Conversely, the 'custom-made' service is a premium solution just for you. Although the cost is higher due to 3D design and individual processing, the aesthetic value, personalization, and perfect fit for your space are absolutely worth it.
FAQ.q5: How long does design and construction take?
FAQ.a5: Normally, the process takes 14-21 days. 3D drawing takes 3-7 days depending on complexity, board ordering 3-5 days, factory production 7-14 days depending on the volume, and transportation/installation takes 3-7 days.
FAQ.q6: What is Happy Furniture's warranty policy?
FAQ.a6: We apply a 12-month warranty policy for all wooden products and hardware (hinges, slides...). After the warranty period, we still support lifetime maintenance at original material costs, committed to always accompanying your living space.
FAQ.q7: Are there any hidden costs for factory construction?
FAQ.a7: Customers can rest assured because the quotation after finalizing the design plan is the Final Quote. We commit to NO hidden costs during construction. Additionally, we offer free installation for customers within a 10km radius around Thuan An, Binh Duong.

WarrantyPage.free1: Technical defects arising from manufacturing or installation processes.
WarrantyPage.free2: Hardware accessories (hinges, drawer slides, handles) malfunctioning under normal use.
